items.summary: Apple just launched its biggest AI push in years, yet a top Apple reporter says the company's whole operating model is wrong for this race. The real risk may be which assistant your habits settle into next, and what that means for AAPL holders.

items.title: If the AI Trade Blows Up, Meta’s Saving Grace Is That Its Social Media Business Still “Generates a Ton of Cash”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDan Niles argues Meta’s ad business would keep producing cash even if the AI trade unwinds, which newly listed Anthropic can’t say. Meta’s ad revenue grew 26% in the third quarter, more than double Pinterest’s 12% revenue growth.

items.title: Anthropic Is Now Worth More Than Bitcoin: Could Bitcoin Pass It by 2030?
items.summary: A company that went public just days ago has already passed the world's biggest cryptocurrency in value. Bitcoin faces ETF outflows, a looming Fed meeting, and a steep climb, so what would it take to win the lead back?

items.title: Meta Platforms (META) Rethinks 2030 Climate Goals After 45% AI Emissions Jump
items.summary: Meta Platforms (NasdaqGS:META) revised its 2030 climate goals after a reported 45% rise in greenhouse gas emissions linked to AI expansion. The company cited rapid AI infrastructure buildout as a key driver of higher emissions and reassessment of its net zero roadmap. Meta is evaluating greater reliance on natural gas powered data centers, raising fresh questions about the mix of its future energy sources.
